en: Reverted a 2.1.268 change that checked Read and Edit deny rules on Bash lines the permission checker can't analyze (`eval`, `env -C`); commands like `time -p make build` prompt again instead of being denied
zh: 回退了 2.1.268 的一项变更：该变更会在权限检查器无法分析的 Bash 行（`eval`、`env -C`）上检查 Read 和 Edit 拒绝规则；现在 `time -p make build` 这类命令会重新弹出权限提示，而不是被拒绝
